open_questions: X's public Developer Console documentation does not publish the exact field labels or final submission label in the first-time developer enrollment flow.
X's public documentation names the app name, description, and use-case inputs but does not publish their exact field labels or the final create-button label.

blockers.problem: The opening omits the Dossier’s billing fact that X API usage is pay-per-usage and charged through the developer account that owns the app.
blockers.suggestion: Add a prerequisite warning that the app’s API consumption uses the owning developer account’s pay-per-usage billing, alongside the existing API-credit requirement.

blockers.problem: The guide provides no recovery action if the one-time Bearer Token display is closed before the token is saved.
blockers.suggestion: Research X's documented Bearer Token regeneration or recovery path, add it to the Research Dossier, and render a concise recovery step in external.md.

history.revision_notes: Research finding: added X’s documented recovery path to research.md under #copy-bearer-token, including reopening the app, opening Keys and tokens, regenerating the Bearer Token, the replacement warning, and saving the newly displayed token; updated provenance fact coverage. External finding: added the owning developer account’s pay-per-usage billing warning beside the API-credit prerequisite. Achievability finding: rendered the concise Bearer Token regeneration path in external.md with the destructive-action warning before Regenerate. Existing anchors were preserved.

research_change.notes: Speakeasy setup materially changed from an unresolved catalog/custom conditional to a forced catalog-only path, backed by the matched catalog record com.pulsemcp.mirror/xdevplatform-xmcp and the new meta.yaml field speakeasy_add_server: catalog. This requires re-rendering speakeasy.md and invalidates review of the prior conditional setup. The further-reading URL also changed from the Mintlify preview to the canonical https://docs.x.com/tools/mcp. Credentials, anchors, remote URL, transport, and prerequisites are otherwise unchanged.
